claims.claim_text: A reputable obituary supports a high-confidence identification of indexed Margot F Reck as Margot Ford Reck, an OSS cartographer who later joined the WASP program.

claims.evidence_paraphrase: The obituary expands the middle initial to Ford and identifies both OSS cartography and 1942 WASP service.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match based on the exact married name, expanded middle initial, and explicit OSS service.
claims.temporal_assessment: The obituary places OSS cartography before or alongside 1942 WASP service, so WASP is not labeled a pre-OSS affiliation.
claims.match_notes: Education and Civil Air Patrol references are identity context only and are not converted into employers.
